description: File-level backup of named paths INSIDE a guest (ADR-012 §3.1) — the subset capability, as opposed to backup:vm's whole-guest snapshot.
_note: install/update-service.sh provision the PBS side (namespace fs/<module>, a write-no-delete login scoped to it, the client-side encryption key) and deploy the guest-side runner + timer. The `backup` policy object this service reads (filesystemPaths and the shared cascade fields) is defined once in the module tier, backup/fields.json — a field defined in two tiers is exactly what the composer refuses.

backup.changeNote: Which paths inside the guest are captured, and how often. Applied by re-writing the capture manifest and re-asserting the namespace/ACL — future captures change, nothing already stored is touched, and the guest keeps running.
